summary: Rise of Nations entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Rise of Nations

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows Extended Edition at current patch level

primary.why: The Extended Edition is the current official PC route, includes Rise of Nations plus Thrones and Patriots, and adds improved visuals plus Steamworks features such as multiplayer, achievements, and cloud saves.
primary.how_to_play: Use Rise of Nations: Extended Edition on Steam or Microsoft Store. Record storefront/build, resolution, multiplayer/service state, and whether the run covers only the base campaign or the Thrones and Patriots expansion content too.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record storefront and multiplayer service state because older GameSpy-era multiplayer is historical.
